name: Asset generation smoke corpus
description: A broad list of production-style assets to generate through the real app flow. This corpus checks mechanics, not creative quality.
mechanicalChecks: the API accepts the generation request
a job or orchestrator action is created
the job reaches a successful terminal state
a production assets row is created with the requested kind/media/role
media assets have delivery metadata such as storage_key or url
failed jobs expose a structured error instead of crashing the flow
